newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ wholesale sales fell 0.2 March qtr on March qtr.
newsitem.headline: NZ wholesale sales fell 0.2 March qtr on March qtr.

text.p: Wholesale sales fell 0.2 percent to $11.5 billion in the March quarter against the March 1996 quarter in the Wholesale Trade Survey, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.

Seven of the 13 storetypes recorded decreases in sales compared with the same period last year with the largest fall in household appliances, furniture and floorcoverings group which dropped 17.5 percent.
Unprocessessed primary products fell 14 percent and motor vehicles 10 percent.
Primary product food posted the largest increase of 14.2 percent while paper and paper products gained 7.3 percent.
The value of stocks held at March 31 was $6.9 billion, 1.1 percent lower than a year earlier. That follows nine consecutive quarterly increases.
For the year to March, total wholesale sales were 1.4 percent higher at $48.6 billion over the March 1996 year.
